description: Web safety hooks — URL pre-screening + prompt-injection scanner for web-fetching tools. Scanner authority: the Rust engine (engine/, built in-tree via `cargo build --release`); the Bash scripts remain as the frozen differential oracle, and as the Layer 7 bridge (agent-result + stop-gate) reading the engine's audit rows.

hooks.command: E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/target/release/web-safety-engine"; if [ -x "$E" ]; then exec "$E" scan --host claude --event pre-tool --config-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}" --default-allowlist "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/web-safety-default-allowlist.txt" --state-mode report --state-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}/engine-state" --state-namespace default; else printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"web-safety: engine binary missing (fail-closed). Build it: cargo build --release in the plugin engine/ directory."}'; fi

E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/target/release/web-safety-engine"; [ -x "$E" ] || exit 0; exec "$E" scan --host claude --event pre-tool --config-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}" --default-allowlist "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/web-safety-default-allowlist.txt" --state-mode report --state-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}/engine-state" --state-namespace default

E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/target/release/web-safety-engine"; if [ -x "$E" ]; then exec "$E" scan --host claude --event post-tool --max-envelope-bytes 8388608 --config-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}" --state-mode report --state-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}/engine-state" --state-namespace default; else printf '%s' '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"web-safety: engine binary missing — this tool result was withheld fail-closed. Build the engine: cargo build --release in the plugin engine/ directory."}'; fi

E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/target/release/web-safety-engine"; [ -x "$E" ] || exit 0; exec "$E" scan --host claude --event post-tool --max-envelope-bytes 8388608 --config-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}" --state-mode report --state-dir "${WEB_SAFETY_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/hooks}/engine-state" --state-namespace default
